units.source_text: 年终快到了。

en.t: The end of the year was drawing near.

units.source_text: 有一天，源氏公子值宿宫邸中，大辅命妇进见。

en.t: One day, while Prince Genji was on night duty at the palace residence, the Myobu of the Assistant Master came to see him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对这命妇并无恋爱关系，只因经常使唤她，相熟之后无所顾忌。

en.t: Prince Genji had no romantic relationship with this Myobu, but because he often called on her services, they had become familiar and no longer stood on ceremony.

units.source_text: 每当她来替公子梳头时，两人往往恣意调笑。

en.t: Whenever she came to comb the prince's hair, the two of them would often joke and flirt freely.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子不召唤时，她有了事自己也来进见。

en.t: For that reason, even when Prince Genji had not summoned her, she would come to him on her own if she had some business.

units.source_text: 此时命妇开言道：“有一桩可笑的事情呢。

en.t: At this point the Myobu began, "There is something rather amusing.

units.source_text: 不对您说，怕说我坏心眼；对您说呢……我弄得没主意了。”

en.t: If I do not tell you, I am afraid you will say I am mean; but if I do tell you... I hardly know what to do."

units.source_text: 她羞答答地微笑，不肯说出来。

en.t: She smiled shyly and would not say it outright.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“什么事情？

en.t: Prince Genji said, "What is it?

units.source_text: 你对我不是无论什么都不隐瞒么？”

en.t: Do you not keep nothing at all hidden from me?"

units.source_text: 命妇吞吞吐吐地说：“哪里隐瞒？

en.t: The Myobu answered hesitantly, "Hidden? How could I hide anything?

units.source_text: 倘是我自己的事情，即使冒昧，我也老早对您说了。

en.t: If it were a matter of my own, I would have told you long ago, even if it was presumptuous of me.

units.source_text: 可是这件事有点说不出口。”

en.t: But this matter is somewhat hard to put into words."

units.source_text: 源氏公子讨厌她，骂道：“你又撒娇了！”

en.t: Prince Genji grew annoyed with her and scolded her, "You are being coy again!"

units.source_text: 命妇只得说出来：“常陆亲王家的小姐送给您一封信。”

en.t: The Myobu had no choice but to say it: "The young lady of Prince Hitachi's household has sent you a letter."

units.source_text: 便取出信来。

en.t: Then she took out the letter.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“原来如此！

en.t: Prince Genji said, "So that is what it was!

units.source_text: 这有什么可隐瞒的？”

en.t: What is there to hide about this?"

units.source_text: 便接了信，拆开来看。

en.t: He took the letter, opened it, and read it.

units.source_text: 命妇心里忐忑地跳，不知公子看了怎么说。

en.t: The Myobu's heart pounded anxiously, not knowing what the prince would say after reading it.

units.source_text: 但见信纸是很厚的陆奥纸[\[14\]](#part1335.html#m14)，香气倒十分浓烈，文字写得尽量工整，诗句是：

en.t: He saw that the letter paper was very thick Michinoku paper[\[14\]](#part1335.html#m14), with a quite powerful fragrance; the handwriting had been made as neat as possible, and the poem read:
